hero.greeting: Hey, I'm Angel Leon — Product Engineer
hero.bio_post_years: building impactful digital products that blend design and engineering. Experienced in Angular, React/Next.js, TypeScript, and collaborating closely with design teams. I care about user experience, product strategy, and delivering features that move metrics. Comfortable working across the stack and bridging the gap between design and development.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
goals: Built and launched Abordando, a dual Next.js platform for a travel agency: catalog, quotations, PlacetoPay WebCheckout payments, hotel inventory through the TBO API, and deployment on AWS (S3, Amplify).

Built Yahisi, a multi-tenant SaaS for kiosks (Next.js admin, SvelteKit kiosk) with real-time ordering, per-tenant isolation with row-level security on Supabase/PostgreSQL, and a public API for the devices.
Designed and built the ADN Run Club landing page, a ticket-sales site in Astro for the club's first major event: brand and color guidelines, WhatsApp checkout, and 170 attendees.

items.title: Frontend Developer
goals: Built an Angular component library reducing code repetition by 50% and improving kiosk development speed by 40%.
Delivered a key project in two weeks by focusing scope and meeting client expectations on time.

items.title: Full stack developer
goals: Built a customizable document templates module, reducing preparation time by 80%.
Operated as the sole developer, meeting 100% of project objectives and deadlines.
Improved UI and core workflows, increasing customer satisfaction by ~80%.
Created an event tracking module for notifications/reminders about legislative changes, improving user awareness and efficiency.

items.title: Full stack developer
goals: Developed an interactive web game that boosted conversion rate by 20%, attracting new users.
Delivered core modules for an application for the Colombian Ministry of Education.
Led the dev team to build an e-learning platform for ANALDEX, reaching ~95% customer satisfaction.

items.title: Abordando — Travel Admin & Client Platform
items.description: Travel management platform built as two Next.js apps: a client-rendered admin dashboard with NextUI and a customer site with SSR and a custom design system on shadcn. I owned it end to end, from architecture to deployment.

items.title: ADN Run Club — Mal de Amores Event Landing Page
items.description: Ticket-sales landing page for MAL DE AMORES, ADN Run Club's first major event: a 5K social run in La Calera, Colombia. I designed and built the site in Astro, defined the brand and color guidelines, and sent checkout straight to WhatsApp. The event brought together 170 people.

items.title: Memento Mori — life in weeks
items.description: Personal project to visualize life in weeks and reflect on time. Designed in Figma with subtle skeuomorphism inspired by classic paper, and built as a PWA with Angular, Ionic, and RxJS.

items.title: Reporter.ia — AI-Powered News Summarizer
items.description: AI news summarizer built at a hackathon in just over a day. I experimented with a skeuomorphic design inspired by print media; it did not translate well to digital, so a redesign is pending.

about.p1_body: who enjoys building products end-to-end. My background is fully technical—most of my career as a full stack engineer—so I bring a strong engineering foundation to every project. I've shipped production apps with Angular, React/Next.js and contributed across the stack with Node (Express/Nest).
about.p2: I care about product impact, user experience, and cross-functional collaboration. Lately I've been sharpening my UX/UI and design systems skills to deliver features that solve real user problems and drive business outcomes.
about.p3: I thrive working on real product challenges, iterating fast, and measuring impact. I enjoy roles where I can bridge design and engineering, and collaborate with product, design, and development teams. If you're hiring for product engineering roles (remote or Spain), let's talk.

meta.title: Angel Leon – Product Engineer
